note: 十段连续专线交接双语文本，待配音。接班复述包含边界、联系人和更新时点；没有推测音频时长或时间轴。

series.title: 专线抖动交接：绕行不等于修复
series.service: checkout to remote inventory over private circuits
series.premise: 日班观察到主专线间歇丢包和时延抖动；少量库存查询已通过批准的备用专线路由绕行。夜班接手供应商跟进、证据采集和明确的升级阈值。
series.outcome: 夜班复述并接手当前小范围绕行、证据与监控；供应商原因仍未确认，不自动切回主线，约定21:00或阈值触发时提前更新。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

recycling.note: 复现使用已存在的网络与交接表达；以下仅为未来候选排期，不计已出现。

dialogues.title: 先交代事实，再交代假设
dialogues.premise: 20:30日夜班交接开始，主专线异常仍未确认原因。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清受影响路径、当前措施和不能宣称已经修复的原因。

lines.en: Okay, we'll hand over the private circuit. Packet loss started around six this evening.
lines.zh: 好，现在交接这条专线。丢包大约今晚六点开始。

lines.en: Which applications use the affected path? I'm the incoming primary on-call tonight.
lines.zh: 哪些应用使用受影响路径？今晚我接任主值班。

lines.en: Checkout inventory queries cross that circuit. Payments use another path and look normal.
lines.zh: 结账的库存查询走这条专线，支付走另一条路径，看起来正常。

lines.en: Have you confirmed a carrier fault? Similar symptoms could come from our equipment.
lines.zh: 确认是运营商故障了吗？我们的设备也可能出现类似症状。

lines.en: No, the root cause is still open. Local interface checks found no obvious errors.
lines.zh: 没有，根因仍未确定。本地接口检查没有发现明显错误。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no repair claim, right? A temporary workaround is active for selected clients.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，不声称已经修复，对吧？目前对选定客户端启用临时绕行。

lines.en: How broad is that workaround currently? I need the exact client scope.
lines.zh: 目前绕行范围多大？我需要准确的客户端范围。

lines.en: Two inventory workers, roughly ten percent of calls. Their configuration versions are in the record.
lines.zh: 两个库存工作进程，大约百分之十调用。记录里有它们的配置版本。

lines.en: Good, don't expand during the handoff itself. Show us the evidence before changing scope.
lines.zh: 好，交接过程中先不扩大范围。改变范围前先看证据。

lines.en: Agreed, scope stays fixed during this call. So, let's review the measured loss first.
lines.zh: 同意，这次会议期间范围不变。先看实测丢包。

dialogues.title: 探测丢包与业务重传互相印证
dialogues.premise: 已确定库存查询路径和绕行范围，展示有时间戳的测量证据。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分ICMP探测结果与实际业务连接证据。

lines.en: Okay, packet loss reaches roughly two percent. That's from the five-minute probe window.
lines.zh: 好，五分钟探测窗内丢包大约达到百分之二。

lines.en: Are those probes ICMP or application traffic? Diagnostic responses can be rate-limited separately.
lines.zh: 是ICMP探测还是应用流量？诊断响应可能单独被限速。

lines.en: ICMP, plus actual TCP retransmission samples. Jitter rises in the same recorded periods.
lines.zh: 有ICMP，也有实际TCP重传样本。同期记录的时延抖动升高。

lines.en: Does that prove where the loss occurs? We still need both endpoint observations.
lines.zh: 这能证明丢包发生在哪里吗？仍需要两端的观察。

lines.en: No, the working hypothesis is path degradation. Client timeout bursts align with those periods.
lines.zh: 不能，当前假设是路径劣化。客户端超时突发与这些时段吻合。

lines.en: Just to confirm, not a location claim, right? Evidence links timing, not the faulty device.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，不是在定位故障设备，对吧？证据关联时序，不确认坏设备。

lines.en: Right, we can't rule that out yet. Congestion and physical errors need separate checks.
lines.zh: 对，尚不能排除其他可能，拥塞与物理错误需要分别检查。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on interface counters. They've stayed clean at our local endpoint.
lines.zh: 我会留意接口计数器。本地端点目前没有错误。

lines.en: Save counters with the same timestamps. Clean local counters don't clear the remote side.
lines.zh: 用相同时间戳保存计数器。本地正常不代表远端正常。

lines.en: So, keep the conclusion narrow for now. Next, review what the carrier actually promised.
lines.zh: 因此当前结论保持谨慎。接下来核对运营商实际承诺。

dialogues.title: 检查时间不是修复时间
dialogues.premise: 证据表明异常时段相关，但尚未定位故障点；交代供应商进展。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清供应商受理、检查时点与修复ETA的区别。

lines.en: Okay, carrier ticket C-four-eighty-two remains open. They acknowledged the evidence at seven thirty.
lines.zh: 好，运营商工单C-482仍开放。他们七点半确认收到证据。

lines.en: What's the ETA for a repair? Did they commit to a restoration time?
lines.zh: 修复预计多久？他们承诺恢复时间了吗？

lines.en: No restoration estimate, only a diagnostic update. That's due at nine this evening.
lines.zh: 没有恢复时间估计，只承诺今晚九点给诊断更新。

lines.en: Which checks have they completed already? An acknowledgment isn't evidence of technical progress.
lines.zh: 他们已经完成了什么检查？受理确认不代表技术进展。

lines.en: They report clean optics at their local handoff. Remote segment counters are still pending.
lines.zh: 他们报告本地交接端光指标正常，远端链路计数器还未提供。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the root cause is still open, right? We haven't verified their remote segment.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，根因仍未定，对吧？还没核实他们的远端链路。

lines.en: Please record that wording in the ticket. Who owns the carrier escalation path?
lines.zh: 把这个措辞写进工单。谁负责运营商升级路径？

lines.en: Raj owns it until this handoff closes. Then Hannah takes the carrier follow-up.
lines.zh: 交接完成前由Raj负责，之后Hannah跟进运营商。

lines.en: Accepted, with ticket access verified first. I'll request the missing remote counter evidence.
lines.zh: 接受，但要先确认工单访问权限。我会索取缺失的远端计数器证据。

lines.en: Compensation discussion? Let's park that for later. So, technical follow-up continues around nine.
lines.zh: 赔偿讨论先留到以后。技术跟进继续在九点左右进行。

dialogues.title: 备用线容量有限，不能盲目全切
dialogues.premise: 供应商尚无修复时间，说明两个工作进程的备用线绕行及容量保护。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清绕行范围、备用容量和恢复旧配置的风险。

lines.en: Okay, the backup circuit serves two workers. It's a temporary workaround, not a repair.
lines.zh: 好，备用专线承接两个工作进程。这是临时缓解，不是修复。

lines.en: How much spare capacity remains there? Does it share the carrier's affected segment?
lines.zh: 那里还剩多少容量？与运营商受影响链路共用吗？

lines.en: Utilization is roughly forty percent right now. Documented routing differs, but physical diversity isn't confirmed.
lines.zh: 当前利用率大约百分之四十。文档路由不同，但物理独立性未确认。

lines.en: Then don't call it fully independent. What's the rollback trigger for this workaround?
lines.zh: 那就不要称它完全独立。这项绕行的回退条件是什么？

lines.en: Sustained utilization above seventy percent means stop expansion. New correctness errors require immediate incident review.
lines.zh: 利用率持续超过百分之七十就停止扩大；新的正确性错误立即进入故障评估。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no automatic return, right? The primary path may still be worse.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，不自动切回，对吧？主路径可能仍更差。

lines.en: Correct, assess both paths before any reversal. Saved settings alone don't make returning safe.
lines.zh: 对，切回前评估两条路径。保存配置不代表回去就安全。

lines.en: The mitigation is holding on these workers. Keep an eye on backup queue depth too.
lines.zh: 这两个工作进程上的缓解仍有效，也要关注备用线队列深度。

lines.en: Record any routing change with its scope. Don't move unrelated services during this shift.
lines.zh: 任何路由变化都记录范围，这个班次不要迁移无关服务。

lines.en: Agreed, expansion needs the incident coordinator's approval. So, leave current routing unchanged for now.
lines.zh: 同意，扩大需要故障协调人批准。所以目前路由不变。

dialogues.title: 超时要核对，不能盲目重试
dialogues.premise: 绕行仅覆盖两个工作进程，主路径业务仍可能超时；交代业务监控。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分库存查询失败、订单状态和重试安全边界。

lines.en: Okay, affected sessions show slower inventory checks. The error rate spiked before the workaround.
lines.zh: 好，受影响会话的库存检查较慢，绕行前错误率曾陡涨。

lines.en: Did any orders reserve inventory twice? Timeouts don't always mean the request failed.
lines.zh: 有订单重复预留库存吗？超时不一定意味着请求失败。

lines.en: No duplicates found in sampled reservations. We reconcile uncertain results using operation identifiers.
lines.zh: 抽样预留里未发现重复。通过操作标识核对不确定结果。

lines.en: Keep an eye on that reconciliation queue. Growing backlog could hide continuing business impact.
lines.zh: 留意核对队列，积压增长可能掩盖持续业务影响。

lines.en: Two workers route differently; that's our blast radius for this change. Other clients still use primary.
lines.zh: 本次变更的影响范围是两个改路由的工作进程，其他客户端仍走主线。

lines.en: Just to confirm, not total incident scope, right? We separate change scope from affected customers.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，这不是整个事件影响范围，对吧？变更范围和客户影响分开描述。

lines.en: Exactly, report those populations separately overnight. Are retries restricted for reservation writes?
lines.zh: 对，夜间分开报告这些群体。库存预留写入的重试受限制吗？

lines.en: Yes, approved idempotency safeguards remain in place. No blanket retry changes during this handoff.
lines.zh: 是，批准的幂等保护仍在，交接期间不统一修改重试。

lines.en: And the mitigation is holding for routed workers? Compare them with primary-path workers separately.
lines.zh: 绕行工作进程缓解持续有效吗？要与主路径进程分开比较。

lines.en: Yes, their timeouts are roughly near baseline. So, preserve both views in the update.
lines.zh: 是，超时大致接近基线。因此更新中保留这两种视图。

dialogues.title: 短抓包、有权限、不带载荷外发
dialogues.premise: 业务指标按路径分别观察，夜班需要继续保存可对齐的网络证据。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清过滤、时钟、容量、访问与供应商分享边界。

lines.en: Okay, the capture filter limits endpoint pairs. The approved capture excludes application payload bytes.
lines.zh: 好，抓包过滤器限制端点对，批准的抓包不包含应用载荷字节。

lines.en: Does truncation still preserve TCP metadata? We need sequence, acknowledgment, and timing fields.
lines.zh: 截断后还保留TCP元数据吗？需要序号、确认号和时间字段。

lines.en: Yes, validated against the actual header lengths. Each bounded capture runs about sixty seconds.
lines.zh: 是，已按实际首部长度验证。每次受限抓包大约六十秒。

lines.en: What prevents the capture filling local storage? Also check permissions before starting it.
lines.zh: 如何防止抓包写满本地存储？开始前也检查权限。

lines.en: The reserved directory has a size cap. Access is restricted to approved incident responders.
lines.zh: 专用目录有容量上限，访问仅限批准的故障响应人员。

lines.en: Just to confirm, follow the retention policy, right? No raw evidence in public chat.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，遵守保留策略，对吧？不在公开聊天里发原始证据。

lines.en: Right, I'll share reviewed summaries with the carrier. Raw transfers require security approval first.
lines.zh: 对，我会向运营商分享审核后的汇总。原始传输先要安全批准。

lines.en: I'm on it for clock status evidence. Let me tail the log alongside captures.
lines.zh: 时钟状态证据我来补，同时盯日志配合抓包。

lines.en: Mark any clock offset in the summary. Otherwise comparing both ends could mislead us.
lines.zh: 汇总里标明时钟偏差，否则两端对比可能误导。

lines.en: So, evidence review is an action item. Keep the originals sealed in controlled storage.
lines.zh: 因此证据审核是一项待办，原始证据封存于受控存储。

dialogues.title: 量化门槛，也保留立即升级条件
dialogues.premise: 证据采集流程已交代，明确夜班升级与扩大绕行的边界。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住连续窗口、正确性风险和联系不到主值班的备用路径。

lines.en: Okay, the escalation threshold is written here. Packet loss above two percent needs attention.
lines.zh: 好，升级门槛写在这里。丢包超过百分之二需要关注。

lines.en: Over what window, and how many times? A single probe failure isn't enough.
lines.zh: 哪个时间窗，连续几次？单次探测失败还不够。

lines.en: Two consecutive five-minute windows on approved probes. Corroborating application timeouts trigger a coordinated review.
lines.zh: 批准探测连续两个五分钟窗超标，并有应用超时印证，就触发协调评估。

lines.en: What bypasses that wait for urgent impact? Complete loss shouldn't wait ten minutes.
lines.zh: 哪些紧急影响不等观察窗？完全中断不能等十分钟。

lines.en: Complete reachability loss or any correctness failure. Page the coordinator immediately in either case.
lines.zh: 完全不可达或任何正确性问题。这两种都立即呼叫协调人。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no automatic reroute, right? The escalation path starts a human decision.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，不自动改路由，对吧？升级路径启动的是人工决策。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll assess capacity before proposing expansion. What's the ETA if nobody responds?
lines.zh: 同意，提出扩大前我先评估容量。没人回应时等多久？

lines.en: After five minutes, page the backup. The roster includes a separate coordinator contact.
lines.zh: 五分钟后呼叫备班，轮值表还有单独的协调人联系方式。

lines.en: Keep the current safe scope while escalating. Silence doesn't authorize a wider reroute.
lines.zh: 升级过程中保持当前安全范围，沉默不授权扩大绕行。

lines.en: So, that's roughly the response ladder. For correctness risks, escalate immediately without waiting.
lines.zh: 这就是大致响应层级。正确性风险立即升级，不等待。

dialogues.title: 接班人复述边界和未决事实
dialogues.premise: 阈值与操作边界明确，接班人检查是否遗漏并复述行动。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出复述中哪些是事实、哪些是未决假设。

lines.en: Let me play that back now. The handoff checklist leaves primary routing mostly unchanged.
lines.zh: 我现在复述一下，交接清单要求主路由大体不变。

lines.en: Okay, exactly two workers use the workaround. The others remain on the primary circuit.
lines.zh: 好，准确说只有两个工作进程绕行，其他仍用主专线。

lines.en: And the root cause is still open. Carrier diagnosis hasn't confirmed a failed segment.
lines.zh: 根因仍未确定，运营商诊断尚未确认故障链路。

lines.en: Correct, and reservation reconciliation stays active. Don't add blanket retries for write operations.
lines.zh: 对，预留核对继续运行，不给写操作增加统一重试。

lines.en: Just to confirm, two windows for loss, right? Correctness failures skip that waiting period.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，丢包看两个时间窗，对吧？正确性问题不等观察期。

lines.en: Yes, assess both paths before changing routing. Have I missed anything about backup capacity?
lines.zh: 是，改路由前评估两条路径。备用容量方面我漏了什么吗？

lines.en: Stop expansion above seventy percent sustained utilization. That doesn't mean automatically return to primary.
lines.zh: 利用率持续超过百分之七十就停止扩大，但不自动回主线。

lines.en: Understood, a temporary workaround with limited scope. I'll collect bounded captures and reviewed summaries.
lines.zh: 明白，是有限范围临时缓解。我负责受限抓包和审核后的汇总。

lines.en: And watch both worker populations separately. Roughly normal routed workers don't clear the incident.
lines.zh: 还要分开看两类工作进程。绕行进程大致正常不代表事件结束。

lines.en: So, that covers the technical handoff. Let's verify actual contact access before acceptance.
lines.zh: 这样技术交接完整了。确认实际联系人可达后再接受交接。

dialogues.title: 姓名、职责和可用联系路径
dialogues.premise: 接班复述正确，验证轮值、供应商入口与升级备选。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分内部决策人、供应商跟进人和备班。

lines.en: Okay, the duty contact list is current. Lukas is primary on-call from this point.
lines.zh: 好，值班联系人表已更新，从现在起Lukas是主值班。

lines.en: I can open the roster and incident record. Who approves any wider routing change?
lines.zh: 我能打开轮值表和事件记录。谁批准更大范围路由变化？

lines.en: The rostered incident coordinator owns that decision. Their paging alias is tested and recorded.
lines.zh: 轮值故障协调人负责该决策，呼叫别名已验证并记录。

lines.en: I'm on it for carrier communications. Ticket access works, but phone escalation needs verification.
lines.zh: 运营商沟通我来负责。工单访问可用，电话升级还要验证。

lines.en: Raj verified the contracted support number earlier. Use the authenticated account reference in storage.
lines.zh: Raj之前验证了合同支持号码，使用受控存储里的认证账号参考信息。

lines.en: Just to confirm, secrets stay out of chat, right? Contact references don't need copied credentials.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，秘密信息不进聊天，对吧？联系记录不需要复制凭据。

lines.en: Agreed, and if I don't respond promptly? Who receives the backup page tonight?
lines.zh: 同意。如果我没及时回应，今晚备班呼叫发给谁？

lines.en: The roster routes it to the backup SRE. Page the backup after about five minutes.
lines.zh: 轮值表会路由到备班SRE，大约五分钟后呼叫备班。

lines.en: The escalation path opens from my account too. We won't depend on an outgoing engineer.
lines.zh: 我的账号也能打开升级路径，不依赖已经下班的工程师。

lines.en: So, contact access is now confirmed. Raj remains available until final acceptance only.
lines.zh: 因此联系权限现在已确认。Raj只在最终接受前继续待命。

dialogues.title: 接手确认和下一次更新
dialogues.premise: 技术边界与联系人均确认，明确21:00更新与提前触发条件。
dialogues.listeningTask: 复述接班负责内容和无新证据时也必须更新的承诺。

lines.en: Just to recap, the next update is nine. That's local time on the incident record.
lines.zh: 小结一下，下次更新九点，按事件记录上的本地时区。

lines.en: I've got it from here on coordination. Two workers remain rerouted; primary diagnosis stays open.
lines.zh: 协调从这里我接手。两个工作进程维持绕行，主线诊断尚未结束。

lines.en: Okay, the mitigation is holding for those workers. Saved configurations and evidence references are attached.
lines.zh: 好，这些工作进程缓解仍有效。已附保存配置和证据引用。

lines.en: I'll request the carrier's pending diagnostic update. No reply still becomes an explicit status.
lines.zh: 我会索取运营商尚未给出的诊断更新。未回复也会明确报状态。

lines.en: I'll monitor reconciliation and both client groups. Any correctness issue gets an immediate page.
lines.zh: 我监控核对和两类客户端。任何正确性问题立即呼叫。

lines.en: Just to confirm, threshold breaches update earlier, right? Don't wait for the scheduled nine.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，超过门槛要提前更新，对吧？不等计划九点。

lines.en: Correct, and routing changes need capacity assessment. We won't automatically restore the primary path.
lines.zh: 对，路由变化需评估容量，不自动恢复主路径。

lines.en: If asked what's the ETA, distinguish diagnosis. We still have no repair estimate.
lines.zh: 被问预计多久时要区分诊断，目前仍没有修复时间估计。

lines.en: Understood, ticket evidence before any recovery claim. Quiet probes alone won't close this incident.
lines.zh: 明白，宣称恢复前需要工单证据。探测平静不能单独关闭事件。

lines.en: So, handoff accepted at roughly eight forty-five. Update at nine even without new findings.
lines.zh: 因此大约八点四十五接受交接。即使没有新发现，九点也更新。
